description:
Apply Government Solutions provides FedHire, the FedRAMP Certified Class C cloud-based talent acquisition platform previously branded as Monster Hiring Management Enterprise (MHME) by Monster Government Solutions. FedHire delivers end-to-end support across the federal hiring and human capital lifecycle, from position classification and vacancy announcement to hiring management and new hire onboarding. As a FedRAMP Certified Class C solution, FedHire is FISMA moderate and built to meet FedRAMP Security Requirements. It meets OMB standards and complies with Section 508 requirements. FedHire is built to integrate across the federal hiring and human capital ecosystem, connecting with systems such as USAJOBS, eOPF, NFC, and IBC - as well as other agency and shared-service platforms - to enable seamless, end-to-end data exchange throughout the hiring lifecycle.

All components of **FedHire** are certified at the Class C (Moderate) impact level and available to all federal agencies:

- **FedHire Hiring Management** is the core applicant tracking system component, integrated with USAJOBS. It supports the creation and posting of job opportunity announcements (JOAs), application management, applicant tracking, candidate referral, and communication among HR staff, hiring managers, and job applicants. It connects to all related FedHire components to support an end-to-end hiring workflow.

- **FedHire Position Classification** uses guided builder wizards with intelligent tools for occupational series and grade-level recommendations to develop position descriptions, functional statements, cover sheets, and evaluation statements, and routes documents through review, approval, and storage workflows with version control and status dashboards. It provides a searchable, agency-specific classification library with document comparison and suggestions, and tracks classification data for reporting.

- **FedHire Job Analysis** facilitates the collaboration between hiring managers and HR teams to document job-specific competencies and appropriate assessment strategies, and links job analysis results to Job Opportunity Announcements (JOAs), crediting plans, and the position description.

- **FedHire Hiring Assessments** provides a framework for delivering external, integrated applicant assessments through third-party assessment providers. The framework is utilized to incorporate standardized, agency-specific, situational-judgment, technical skills, and other assessment methodologies into agency hiring workflows, with assessment results returned to the applicant record to support screening, ranking, and review by HR professionals and hiring managers.

- **FedHire Collaborate** creates and assigns subject matter expert (SME) panels to review and score applicants, centralizing vacancy details, scoring parameters, and applicant materials in one location. It collects numerical ratings and narrative feedback from SMEs, averages or consensus-scores candidates, and combines with other assessments into a weighted cumulative score. HR can review, accept, or return SME ratings, and the module documents panel participants, dates, scores, and comments for audit purposes.

- **FedHire Selecting Official** provides hiring managers (selecting officials) with tools to review job postings, select assessment criteria, review certificates of eligible applicants, submit annotated certificates to HR, and share certificates across their agency and with other agencies that are granted access.

- **FedHire Onboarding / FedHire Onboarding+** (certified 9/25/2025) automates entrance-on-duty processing for new hires, populates onboarding forms from application data, coordinates provisioning across agency departments, and integrates with agency HRIS platforms. Onboarding+ includes and integrates with USAJOBSs’ agency-branded new hire portal and OPM's eOPF. It allows customized agency-branded documents and templates.

- **FedHire Analytics** enables review of audit-enabled vacancies and associated documentation for compliance with HR procedures.

- **FedHire Auditor** enables review of audit-enabled vacancies and associated documentation for compliance with HR procedures.

To learn more about the FedHire talent acquisition system (TAS), visit: https://www.applygovernmentsolutions.com/solutions/fedhire/

description:

Avature Federal Platform is a highly configurable Human Capital Management System, which enables U.S. federal, state, and local government customers, as well as U.S. government contractors, and Federally Funded Research and Development Centers (FFRDCs) to implement modern approaches to help identify, attract, hire, develop and retain talented people in highly competitive labor markets. The application allows users to create forms and cases and route them through the agency's business process. The application also features specialized tools to support Federal HR including our retirement benefits calculator, PD+, our position management repository, and supports integrations with Federal government systems. FedHR Navigator supports talent acquisition, position management and classification, performance management, awards, personnel actions, benefits, retirement, separation, employee and labor relations, and workforce planning. FedHR also features specialized reporting and data visualization for Diversity, Equity, Inclusion and Accessibility.

description:
GDCI provides proven, efficiently priced Federalized SaaS Human Resource
Applications to support the critical human capital functions across the employee
lifecycle.

Time, Attendance & Leave:
Paycheck 8 reduces the challenging and time consuming effort of tracking and reporting time, attendance, and leave (including VLTP and FLMA). Utilizing agency/department
business rules, Paycheck8 pre-edits to eliminate and reduce time-entry errors, corrected T&A’s and Leave balances. 

Labor and Employee Relations:
Labor-Employee Relations Information System (LERIS) is a state-of-the-art case management and reporting system designed to meet the needs of the labor/employee relations specialist, EEO case manager and other HR specialists, along with agency leadership.

Performance Management:
ePM is a proven web-based HR system developed to support the effective management, process development, and performance tracking of the appraisal process from start to finish, while maintaining compliance with performance and awards laws.

Onboarding:
eForms is innovative technology designed to improve productivity and eliminate redundant manual data entry for new employee enrollment. It is inclusive of the new hire process and management of enrollment forms and procedures.

HR Self Service:
Connect HR is an easy to manage HR dashboard designed to leverage the benefits of single sign on, role management, collaboration, communication, business intelligence and document management.

Personnel Actions & Awards Tracking:
eTracker is a tool developed to easily and efficiently manage, process and track Request for Personnel Action (SF 52), Notification of Personnel Action (SF 50) and Awards Processing.

Uniform Management:
The Uniform Allowance Management System (UNAW) conveniently provides complete processing, tracking and approval of uniform allowance requests online.

Organizational Chart Automation:
FedChart is a workforce planning tool that automates the creation, maintenance, and updating of organizational charts, adhering to agency-specific business rules and
requirements. Utilizing federal HR data, FedChart visualizes an agency’s organizational structure, positions, and workforce costs.

HR Data Reporting Automation:
FedLens is a research-based, three module tool designed to enhance data-driven workforce management and planning through automated reports, trend analysis, and predictive analytics. It comprises three modules (Diagnostics, Snapshots, and Predictions) which provide insight based on data benchmarked against standards from the Office of Personnel Management (OPM).

FEVS Data Reporting Automation:
FedViews is an automated tool for Federal Employee Viewpoint Survey (FEVS) reporting, trend analysis, and workforce planning. It assists federal agencies in generating FEVS reports in compliance with OPM requirements and enables federal HR leaders to compare viewpoint data over time, identify trends, and benchmark scores across departments and within agencies. Action planning modules allow agencies to develop targeted action planning to improve engagement over time.

description:
Perceptyx's online employee engagement survey technology is built to support four phases of service to Perceptyx clients, including a configuration module to support planning and survey set-up, data collection module, diagnostic reporting module and action planning module, each module runs on the Perceptyx proprietary web software platform.

Using the Perceptyx real-time technology for each phase of a project, Perceptyx can create web applications specifically suited to the unique data collection and reporting needs of any organization. From creation to collection to interactive result reporting, the whole process is done in real-time and is hosted on the Perceptyx robust, secure network.

Perceptyx technology supports performance improvement services for each client in the following phases:

1. Design, development, configuration, and testing.
2. Deploy, data collection, training, and monitoring.
3. Analysis, diagnosis, and final report configuration.
4. Report distribution, action planning, and executive presentations.

Each phase of the project provides specific services for the client leveraged by the Perceptyx technology and facilitated by Project Managers.

The services included as part of the Perceptyx Insights Platform include the following:

1. Ask Service - Point-in-time employee surveys to illuminate the employee experience
2. Sense Service - Lifecycle surveys and always-on listening to keep pace with your people
3. Dialogue Service - Crowdsourced insights to engage your people on the topics that matter most
4. Develop Service - Multi-rater feedback to improve manager effectiveness and build leaders
